body:
Ross:

> This psych report should be enough to resolve the question of whether
> TK was part of the New Left, if Scott or Alex provide a working
> definition.  Alex, would you like to take my bet for $10,000 that the
> report will prove that he hated members of the New Left (and did not
> identify with the New Left) at all?

I am not that wealthy, but I would be willing to wager about
$30 that TK was not a Nazi sympathizer.  I think he is perhaps
best described as a highly individualistic, left-leaning,
socially disfunctional wannabe ecodefender.  The quotes below support 
my claim that  in his heart of hearts he supports some "left-leaning"
views, 
in spite of his hatred of the leftist persons.  (what type of
person did TK LIKE?)

I suspect that TK would oppose totalitarian fascism just as much
as totalitarian communism, but he felt that so may people were
already aware of this threat, that it was not worth mentioning
(like the foolish conservatives) It's fascinating that the FBI 
so strongly pursued the Nazi/FC theory, but I think the FBI was 
wrong. I would concede the bet if, for example,  Frank Collins 
prominently appears in any of TK's writings.

In the following passages, TK goes out of his way to prove
FC is not racist.  You may say this is just for PR
purposes.  Perhaps, but I think it reveals something of
his character.


ISAIF:

From 11:


   They  [leftists] want to replace the word "primitive" by
"nonliterate." They seem
   almost paranoid about anything that might suggest that any primitive
   culture is inferior to our own. (We do not mean to imply that
   primitive cultures ARE inferior to ours. We merely point out the
   hypersensitivity of leftish anthropologists.)

   
   13. Many leftists have an intense identification with the problems of
   groups that have an image of being weak (women), defeated (American
   Indians), repellent (homosexuals), or otherwise inferior. The
leftists
   themselves feel that these groups are inferior. They would never
admit
   it to themselves that they have such feelings, but it is precisely
   because they do see these groups as inferior that they identify with
   their problems. (We do not suggest that women, Indians, etc., ARE
   inferior; we are only making a point about leftist psychology).

Notice how ironically the last sentance of 13 can be subjected
the very criticism TK levels against leftists in 13.

obiwan
